home.cold.comment: Cold home loads the full ordered app module graph plus digest preview awareness on boot (aPreview). Digest-decouple train base measured ~436015 gzip wire bytes p95 in CI. T3 attachment related-notices adds ~0.8–1.2 KB gzip on the always-loaded path (alerts/routing/i18n/index chrome only); the related JSON artifact and client helper load only on attachment-bearing notice detail, not home cold. Ceiling 440000 keeps small headroom without masking a sudden step. Ratchet target: under 430000 after a home-path load split that defers alerts preview awareness.

contracts.keyword-housing.comment: The 20-sample pre-change p95 measured 212 ms; 225 ms prevents regression. Ratchet target: 200 ms.
